TutorGate browser renderer vendor snapshot, 2026-09-10.

Upstream: https://github.com/kisonecat/tikzjax
Published bundle: https://tikzjax.com/v1/tikzjax.js
WASM/core: https://s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/tikzjax.com/
Fonts: https://tikzjax.com/bakoma/ttf/ (BaKoMa font collection)

The upstream JS bundle is distributed as tikzjax-local.js, modified only to
replace its hardcoded S3 asset root with self.location.origin + /vendor/tikzjax.
worker.js is TutorGate's separate worker adapter; it does not execute SVG in a DOM.
All resources are served locally. No user code is sent to TikZJax or a third party.
Upstream LPPL license: LICENSE.md. Font terms: fonts/LICENSE.txt.
The upstream source repository and original bundle remain available at URLs above.
No application npm dependency versions or lockfiles were changed.
Additional local change: a compile-phase message was added immediately before
WASM execution, separating the asset download timeout from the CPU timeout.
